question: An integrated circuit is commonly known as a:
solution:
The correct answer is **__Chip.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **An IC or Integrated Circuit, also known as a microchip, chip, or microelectronic circuit **is an assembly of electronic components which are

 fabricated as a single unit.
 
• The active and passive devices such as transistors and resistors and their interconnections are built on a thin substrate of silicon, a semiconductor material.
 
• **Integrated circuits are the chips** of Silicon on which transistors, logical gates, resistors or capacitors are embedded.
 
• The first IC was developed by **Jack Kilby and Robert Noyce in 1958**, but the concept was introduced by** Geoffrey Dummer in 1952**.
 
• These building blocks of a circuit can act as microprocessors, amplifiers, memory etc.
